gates: Author genuine-request positives and strict malformed/identity/link/clock negatives under CPython3.9 and3.12.
Independent final controls and source/manifest linkage.
Fresh affected REHEARSAL proof with the new source; old r12 worlds and BOUNDs remain historical.
New measured operative runtime and Linux/owner authority remain separate gates.
invariants: utc_instant and all receipt clock parsing and every other caller remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

The existing strict UTC_SECOND fullmatch accepts only whole-second UTC Z or +00:00; parse_utc normalizes through +00:00 for CPython3.9 compatibility and refuses invalid types, timezone offsets, fractional seconds and invalid calendar values.
Every existing K3 completeness, same-identity, BOUND source, request digest, bootstrap citation and copy provenance check remains unchanged.
Chronology and same-day bounds after the two parser calls remain unchanged.
The two calls do not reread, rewrite or reseal REQUEST buffers.
limits: Static source review only; it does not claim executed corrected A7 prepare or whole-chain L2.
No old proof transfers automatically to new source bytes.
